why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Morfi demo Press Try Morfi on the homepage to open the markets list in demo mode.
2 Step 2 : Browse the markets Look through the debates on offer, from sports and politics to crypto and culture, and compare the outcome percentages, prize pools and trader counts shown on each.
3 Step 3 : Read how a market settles Scroll the Morfi homepage to the three stages, debate starts, consensus builds and debate settled, to see how a market goes live and closes.
4 Step 4 : Install the mobile app Morfi lists an iPhone app on the App Store and an Android app on Google Play .
5 Step 5 : Follow the project Morfi posts build updates on X and runs a community chat on Telegram .
